title: Useful app but...
body:
Any options you want to change, you have to go pro and it almost feels like it’s forcing you to do so. The alarm is irritatingly soft you’re most likely to miss it. And when you decide to do so, guess what, you have to pay for it. 

Find another app if you don’t want an app asking you to pay for everything that’s not a “default” setting.
